title: Weld Tech Group - Metal Structures and Service Platforms
meta_description: Manufacturing and installation of metal structures: trusses, stairs, railings, frames. High welding precision, corrosion protection, reliability!.
main_description: We manufacture and install metal structures of various complexity, including trusses, stairs, railings, frames for control cabinet mounting, and much more. All products meet strength and safety standards.

materials.title: Types of materials for metal structures:

steel.title: Carbon steel (St.20)
steel.description: Structures can be coated with powder paints or chemically resistant enamels; suitable for use both indoors and outdoors.

aluminum.title: Aluminum and alloys
aluminum.description: Light, mobile, and durable solutions, especially important when frequent relocation or transportation of structures is required.

stainless.title: High-alloy (stainless) steels (AISI–316L, AISI–304L, AISI–430)
stainless.description: Characterized by high corrosion resistance, elegant appearance, and are ideal for food, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries.

bottom_description: Welding is performed using WIG–TIG (AC/DC) and MIG–MAG methods, which ensures high precision, clean welds, and long service life of structures.

realisations.title: Our Realizations
realisations.description: Each of our projects reflects exact fulfillment of customer requirements, a well-thought-out economic model, and impeccable technical execution.
